excerpt: posts/llm_are_beautifully_ugly.md # LLMs are beautifully ugly ![img]( Yes. They are beautiful cause they get things done in tremendous small amount of time, all I need is to create a proper [skill.md]( for them And they are ugly cause they hallucinate here and there. At least with my GROQ free tier `openai/gpt-oss-120b`. Maybe I'll need a paid plan, but even smart and powerful LLMs sometimes blew it up, but I don't care ... Why? Cause one day they will be fixed and they will give me 99.99% correct result. As for now I'm happy cause they are - Enable me to explore my [tools / frameworks]( LLMs is extremely useful when generating code for my system and showing me what they could be: [Test Caddy web server installation on Rocky Linux]( using Raku for task checks - Dramatically minimizing time that I need to show others use cases for my framework: > [QA]( > Automation > Devops --- So, while the dust from AI hype is not settled, I see ( the bright ) future in hallucinating lenses \~\~\~ LLMS are ( ugly ) .beautiful!.
